readerCopy.body: Trying to sound reasonable can hide the exact objection the conversation needs in order to become honest. When Mercury squares Lilith, communication and refusal create friction, making a genuine no leak out through sarcasm, overexplaining, or careful language that never states the point. The problem is not always the tone. Sometimes the message is being asked to sound enough like agreement that nobody has to respond to the disagreement underneath it.
